purpose: Comprehensive master blueprint of all enterprise DevOps capabilities, patterns, tools, configurations, and step-by-step implementation instructions to replicate or adopt in any target project.

application_stack.client_tier: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS SPA (Single Page Application)
application_stack.edge_tier: Nginx 1.27 Alpine (Static file server, SPA router, and reverse proxy for /api/*, /prometheus/*, /grafana/*)
application_stack.application_tier: Python 3.12 Flask + Gunicorn WSGI REST API (stateless, non-root appuser)
application_stack.database_tier: MongoDB 7.0 Community Edition (isolated on private container bridge network)
application_stack.monitoring_tier: Prometheus (v2.50.1) metrics scraper + Grafana (10.4.0) visualization dashboard
application_stack.automation_tier: Jenkins (LTS JDK17) Declarative 8-stage CI/CD pipeline + Ansible configuration manager

core_design_principles: Zero Cloud Financial Footprint ($0.00 Total) strictly within AWS Free Tier
Day 1 Bootstrapping to Day 2 Idempotent Configuration Management evolution
Cloud-Native Dual Deployment (AWS EC2 Cloud Host + Local Minikube Kubernetes Cluster)
Shift-Left DevSecOps with automated container and filesystem vulnerability gating
Resource Hardening: Linux swap memory engineering to run heavy stacks on 1GB RAM instances
Windows Storage Safety: Relocating Docker VHDX and Minikube cache strictly to D: drive (0 bytes on C:)

1_containerization_docker.description: Multi-stage hardened container builds published to Docker Hub

frontend_strategy.stage_1_build: node:20-alpine (copies package*.json, runs npm ci, builds Vite dist bundle)
frontend_strategy.stage_2_runtime: nginx:1.27-alpine (copies only /dist to /usr/share/nginx/html, injects custom nginx.conf)
frontend_strategy.benefits: Image size reduced from ~450MB to <30MB; zero Node.js/npm runtime dependencies in production

backend_strategy.pattern: Two-stage multi-stage build with non-root security context
backend_strategy.stage_2_runtime: python:3.12-slim (copies /install to /usr/local, creates non-root appuser/appgroup, executes via Gunicorn 2 workers)
backend_strategy.benefits: Compilers and temporary build tools eliminated from production image; non-root execution prevents container escape

docker_compose_architecture.local_compose: docker-compose.yml (unifies all 6 containers: frontend :3001, backend :5000, mongo :27017, prometheus :9090, grafana :3002, jenkins :8080)
docker_compose_architecture.production_compose: docker-compose.prod.yml (exposes only Nginx on port 80; backend, mongo, and monitoring communicate over private bridge zestora_net)

daemon_logging_governance.purpose: Prevents Docker container logs from consuming 100% of host disk space

2_cloud_infrastructure_aws.compute_instance: EC2 t3.micro (1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS)

networking.subnet: Public Subnet (172.31.16.0/20) with direct Internet Gateway route

security_group_rules.description: Public HTTP traffic to Nginx edge

zero_cost_budget_rules: Use EC2 standard auto-assigned public IPv4 (bypasses AWS $0.005/hr Elastic IP charge)
Do NOT provision AWS NAT Gateway (saves ~$32/month)
Do NOT provision AWS Application Load Balancer (saves ~$16/month; handled by Nginx container)
Do NOT provision AWS RDS / DocumentDB (saves ~$25/month; handled by MongoDB container on EBS)
Stay within 750 free instance hours/month and 30 GB free gp3 EBS storage

linux_memory_engineering.problem: A 1 GB RAM instance crashes when compiling Vite bundles or running MongoDB and Gunicorn simultaneously (OOM killer kill -9)
linux_memory_engineering.solution: 2 GB persistent swapfile with kernel swappiness tuning
commands: fallocate -l 2G /swapfile || dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile bs=1M count=2048

modules.vpc_tf: Provisions custom VPC, public subnets, and internet gateway attachments
modules.ec2_tf: Defines instance type t3.micro, assigns key_name, root block device (20GB gp3), and security group
modules.outputs_tf: Exports public IP and public DNS endpoints

playbook_tasks: 1. Install prerequisite system packages (ca-certificates, curl, gnupg, git)
2. Add official Docker GPG key and APT repository
3. Install Docker Engine, Docker CLI, and Docker Compose Plugin
4. Start and enable Docker system service
5. Provision 2 GB swapfile and configure vm.swappiness=10
6. Configure Docker daemon.json with 10MB log rotation limits
7. Synchronize docker-compose.prod.yml and application configuration to target host
8. Deploy containers via community.docker.docker_compose_v2 (pull: always, state: present)
9. Execute automated curl smoke tests against /healthz and /api/health
4_configuration_management_ansible.idempotency_benefits: Can run repeatedly with zero configuration drift; deploys updates without terminating or recreating virtual machines

jenkins_server.deployment_method: Docker container running jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk17 on port 8080
jenkins_server.pipeline_type: Declarative Pipeline (SCM pointing to repository Jenkinsfile)

jenkins_8_stages.action: Clones latest commit from GitHub repository
Substage 2A: Python unittest (test_app.py); Substage 2B: npm run type-check & lint
Trivy scans repo files and dependencies for Critical/High CVEs
Builds optimized frontend and backend production images
Trivy audits container layers for OS package vulnerabilities
Tags and pushes versioned images to AWS ECR or Docker Hub
Runs terraform init, validate, and plan on IaC definitions
Executes remote deployment and verifies HTTP 200 healthcheck status

6_kubernetes_and_minikube_orchestration.local_engine: Minikube v1.39.0 (Kubernetes v1.37.0 Control Plane on containerd runtime)
6_kubernetes_and_minikube_orchestration.driver: docker (runs as a lightweight container inside Docker Desktop)

drive_storage_isolation.result: All VM layers, preloaded tarballs, certificates, and caches stay on D: drive (0 bytes on C:)

manifest_suite_k8s.namespace_yaml: Creates dedicated 'zestora' isolated namespace with environment metadata
manifest_suite_k8s.configmap_secrets_yaml: Injects base64-encoded JWT secrets and database connection strings
manifest_suite_k8s.mongo_statefulset_yaml: StatefulSet with 1 replica + Headless ClusterIP Service + volumeClaimTemplates provisioning a 5Gi PersistentVolume
manifest_suite_k8s.backend_deployment_yaml: 3 Replicas pulling Docker Hub image, configured with livenessProbe and readinessProbe on port 5000
manifest_suite_k8s.frontend_deployment_yaml: 2 Replicas pulling Docker Hub image, configured with Nginx reverse proxy and RollingUpdate strategy
manifest_suite_k8s.services_upstream_yaml: ClusterIP internal DNS services ('backend', 'grafana', 'prometheus') allowing Nginx upstream name resolution without pod crashes
manifest_suite_k8s.hpa_yaml: HorizontalPodAutoscalers (v2) dynamically scaling replicas from 2 to 10 based on 70% CPU and 80% Memory thresholds

minikube_cli_commands.deploy: kubectl apply -f k8s/namespace.yaml && kubectl apply -f k8s/
minikube_cli_commands.visual_dashboard: minikube dashboard (opens official Kubernetes Web GUI in browser)
minikube_cli_commands.service_tunnel: minikube service zestora-frontend -n zestora (opens app directly in browser)

devsecops_trivy.purpose: Shift-left vulnerability management in CI/CD pipeline and local audit

observability_prometheus.traffic_simulation_tool: scripts/load_simulate.py (generates realistic mock orders and traffic to populate telemetry)

observability_grafana.dashboards: Real-time revenue meters, active order gauges, HTTP 2xx/4xx/5xx error rate graphs

gitignore_best_practices: Include local test and interview cheat sheets (PROJECT_REVIEW_GUIDE.md, QUICK_LINKS.md, AWS_RESOURCE_INVENTORY_AND_TEARDOWN.md)
Include local automation scripts (*.ps1 personal scripts) to prevent platform scanning flags

git_branching_model.synchronization_rule: Always push to both origin project:main AND origin project:project to ensure CI/CD and deployment parity

branding_and_polish.html_title: Set informative <title> tag in index.html (e.g. 'Zestora – Fresh Food Delivered Fast' instead of generic 'frontend')
branding_and_polish.favicon: Provide brand SVG favicon in /public/favicon.svg to eliminate generic browser globe icon

step_by_step_adoption_checklist_for_new_: Step 1: Containerize application using two-stage multi-stage Dockerfiles (build stage + minimal alpine/slim runtime).
Step 2: Tag and push production images to Docker Hub under a public namespace.
Step 3: Provision AWS EC2 t3.micro ($0.00 Free Tier) and configure 2GB swap memory with vm.swappiness=10.
Step 4: Write Terraform IaC modules in terraform/ for VPC, Security Group, and EC2 provisioning.
Step 5: Write Ansible inventory and deploy-playbook.yml for automated, idempotent host setup and container launch.
Step 6: Configure Jenkins Declarative 8-stage pipeline with parallel testing, Trivy DevSecOps scans, and smoke tests.
Step 7: Author Kubernetes production manifests in k8s/ (Deployments, StatefulSets, ClusterIP Upstreams, HPAs).
Step 8: Deploy manifests into Minikube (using D: drive storage configuration) and verify pods with 'minikube dashboard'.
Step 9: Expose Prometheus business metrics in backend and visualize in Grafana.
Step 10: Document architecture, endpoints, and commands in README.md with live Mermaid diagrams.
